waivers.rationale: The Flink DataStream job has no httplib2 import or HTTP client path. Its ingress is Kafka, and it never processes attacker-controlled compressed HTTP response bodies.
waivers.removal_condition: Remove this waiver when a supported apache-flink/apache-beam dependency set accepts httplib2>=0.32.0, or immediately if an httplib2 call path is added.

waivers.rationale: The job uses the DataStream STRING/pickle path and never opens Arrow IPC files or enables metadata pre-buffering; the affected IPC file-reader path is unreachable.
waivers.removal_condition: Remove this waiver when a supported apache-flink/apache-beam dependency set accepts pyarrow>=23.0.1, or immediately if the job adopts Arrow IPC file reads.

python-profiles.inventory: uv export --frozen --all-extras --no-emit-project (runtime, every declared extra, dev)

waivers.rationale: Upstream has published no fix (`fixed_in: []`; the advisory itself says "Patched versions: Not yet patched"), so this is a waiver of an open advisory rather than a deferred upgrade. The affected APIs are the nltk model-persistence helpers -- TransitionParser.train/parse, AveragedPerceptron.save/load, PerceptronTagger.save_to_json, save_maxent_params -- and the bypass only means anything to a caller that enables nltk's pathsec sandbox and lets untrusted input choose model paths. AgentFlow imports neither: nltk arrives only as a transitive dependency of llama-index-core under the `integrations` extra, `git grep` finds no `nltk` or `pathsec` reference in src/, sdk/, integrations/ or scripts/, and the package is absent from requirements-docker.lock, so it does not ship in the API image.
waivers.removal_condition: Remove this waiver when nltk publishes a fixed release and the lock takes it -- pip-audit will report a fix version, the waiver will stop matching, and this gate will go red on its own. Remove it immediately if AgentFlow ever imports nltk or enables nltk.pathsec.
